Errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Errors.forbidden: You don’t have access to that.
Errors.instrumentNotFound: We don’t track that skill or role yet.
Errors.rolesCannotBeHeld: Roles can be watched, not held.
Errors.alreadyWatching: That’s already on your watchlist with this filter.
Errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
Errors.pageBody: The page hit an error. Nothing you did was lost.
Errors.notFoundTitle: That page isn’t on the board
Errors.notFoundBody: It may have moved, or the link has a typo.
Errors.chatStateChanged: This chat changed in the meantime. Here’s where it’s at now.
Errors.slotTaken: That time was just taken. Please pick another.
Errors.tooLateToCancel: Chats can only be cancelled up to 24 hours before they start.
Errors.tooEarlyToConfirm: You can do this once the chat time has passed.
Errors.studentPaused: New requests are paused for 30 days after two missed chats. See the no-show rules.
Errors.candidateUnavailable: This person can’t take requests right now. Please choose someone else.
Errors.invalidEmail: That doesn’t look like an email address.
Errors.freeEmailDomain: That looks like a personal or student email. Use your work email, or ask for a manual review.
Errors.codeFormat: Enter the 6 digits from the email.
Errors.codeExpired: That code has expired. Send a new one.
Errors.codeAttempts: Too many tries. Send a new code.
Errors.codeIncorrect: That code doesn’t match. Check the email and try again.
Errors.availabilityMissing: Add at least one time window.
Errors.aliasInvalid: Use 1–40 lowercase letters, numbers, spaces or + # . / -
Errors.aliasExists: That alias already points to this instrument.
Errors.aliasConflict: That alias already points to another instrument.
